The Gate That Opened at Dawn

黎明时打开的城门 · 645 词 · 8 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1A town stood on a river frontier between two countries. During a civil war, an army occupied its castle and closed the bridge. A rebel force controlled the western road. A civilian nurse, Asha, had to carry medicine across for a child. A soldier at the gate told her that the command had ordered a temporary withdrawal from the bridge. The enemy could still attack from a nearby hill. He asked her to wait until the next guard arrived.

2A diplomat brought the commander a ceasefire offer after a fierce offensive. The siege had cut the province off from its capital. A battalion that once defended the bridge had split during an imperial succession dispute. Some joined the rebellion, while others served the royal army. The agreement would not settle sovereignty or territorial claims. It would let civilians leave the occupied zone for an hour. Asha asked why a medical mission had been treated as an act of aggression.

3She opened the case. A guard set his rifle down. A young recruit wanted to inspect every bottle. He had seen a raid start with a false declaration. The senior officer feared delay more than deception. An intelligence officer had warned of an abandoned missile near the bridge. Asha showed the stamp, offered to keep the load visible, and asked which route the guards considered safe. Their tense confrontation gave way to a practical question. No side wanted to threaten the passage it had just agreed to protect.

4The schoolteacher stayed despite the occupation. Her brother had gone into exile after an earlier clash. She wanted to carry a white cloth to the middle of the bridge. It would indicate neutrality. A messenger rode to provincial headquarters to confirm the hour. Asha and the guard marked a waiting place by a ruined wall. People who had fought in the resistance feared that the troops would recognize them. The teacher asked both commanders to keep old accusations out of the check.

5The gate officer still feared that a soldier might bring a weapon onto the bridge. A former combat medic proposed keeping guards at both ends but leaving the middle clear. Asha asked whether each side would cease fire there even if the latter group moved slowly. The commander gave a public commitment. It offered neither a surrender nor a general peace. In that tense hour, diplomacy gave the families a passage through hostile territory.

6The treaty officer could promise one hour. Asha suggested letting the first group carry a list of those still waiting. A commander feared it could expose a military secret. The teacher offered to record names on the bridge with both guards watching. One of them had left his southern homeland during the invasion. He remembered how warfare could destroy records as well as houses. He agreed to check each family before anyone tried to resist the passage.

7At dawn the nurse crossed first, before the eastern army came into view. A blast in the distance made a few people run, but the two commanders held their positions. The guard who had questioned her came halfway onto the bridge and helped a woman carry a bag. No new battle followed. The one-hour pause did not bring liberation to the town. It let families cross a line that had divided them the night before. Asha reached the hospital before the gate shut.

8Years later a monument stood beside the bridge. One historic proclamation called the guard a victorious warrior. A later account praised the town's liberation after a revolution. Asha remembered the violence and the brutality more clearly than anyone's claim to heroism. She asked the writer to include a nurse's case and a schoolteacher's cloth. A modest deed had made the treaty useful to those who crossed. A child could follow that act without learning the dynasty or the names of every corps.

四级汇总词汇 · 23中文译文

黎明时打开的城门

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1一座城镇位于两国交界的河岸。内战中，一支军队占领城堡，封住桥。反叛部队掌控西边的路。平民护士阿莎得给河对岸的孩子送药。门口士兵说，指挥部已下令暂时撤离桥面，敌军仍可能从附近山头进攻。他请她等下一个守卫来。

2一场猛烈攻势后，外交人员把停火提议交给指挥官。围城切断了该省与首府的联系。原来守桥的一个营在帝国继承争执中分裂，有人参加叛乱，有人留在王室军队。协议解决不了主权或领土诉求，却能给平民一小时离开占领区。阿莎问，送药怎么会被当成挑衅。

3她打开药箱，一名守卫放下步枪。新兵想查每个瓶子，因为他见过突袭从一份虚假申报开始。高级军官更怕耽误时间。一名情报人员曾说桥边有枚被遗弃的导弹。阿莎出示医院印章，愿意让箱子里的东西始终看得见，也问守卫哪条路安全。紧张的对峙逐渐变成一个实际问题。双方都不希望威胁这条刚同意保护的通道。

4一位教师在占领期间留在镇上。早先一次冲突让她哥哥流亡在外。她想把白布带到桥中央，表明中立。信使赶到省指挥部确认时间。阿莎和守卫在断墙旁标出等候区。参加过抵抗的人怕军队认出他们。老师请两方指挥官在检查时搁下旧指控。

5看门军官还怕有士兵把武器带上桥。一位前战地医护人员提议两端留守卫，中间空出来。阿莎问，后面的人走得慢，两边是否也会按时停火。指挥官公开承诺。那一小时不足以让谁投降或带来全面和平，却让外交协商为各家人在敌对地区开出一条路。

6负责协议的人只能承诺一小时。阿莎建议让首批过桥的人带上后面等候者的名单。指挥官担心名单泄露军事机密，老师提出在桥上登记，让两方守卫都看见。其中一人曾在入侵时离开南边的故乡。他记得战争不仅摧毁住房，也会毁掉记录。他同意逐户查验，免得通行受阻。

7天亮时，东边军队还没露面，护士先过了桥。远处爆炸让几个人跑起来，两边指挥官仍留在原位。先前盘问她的守卫走到桥中间，帮一位妇女提包。没有再打起来。短暂的停火没有解放小镇，却让几家人跨过昨晚还分隔彼此的那条线。关门前，阿莎赶到了医院。

8多年后，桥边立了一块纪念碑。旧公告称守卫是胜利的勇士，后来记录称赞革命后小镇获得解放。阿莎记得的暴力与残酷，比任何英雄说法更鲜明。她请撰写者加上护士的药箱和教师的白布。正是一个小行动，让协议对过桥的人有用。孩子无须学会王朝和每支军队的名字，也能讲清这件事。
